title: The Garden That Vanished Overnight
intro: Picture a lush garden, heavy with ripening fruit and surrounded by towering trees. Those who tended it thought themselves clever, planning their harvest in the quiet hours before dawn, away from the eyes of those in need. But the One who never sleeps had other plans for their hidden bounty. Can you guess who stands behind this cautionary tale from the Quran?
clues: We once possessed a garden so lush and abundant that it became the envy of all who passed by.
In our planning, we whispered to one another early in the morning, declaring that no needy soul would be allowed to enter that day.
We were people of wealth, and our hearts had grown blind to the rights of the poor around us.
When the dawn of our intended harvest arrived, we approached our garden only to find it transformed into a blackened ruin overnight.
A devastating decree swept through, leaving nothing but ashes where clusters of ripe fruit had once hung.
Our tale is a stern warning recorded in the Quran, where we are known as the owners of the garden who withheld charity from the needy.
